posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif shared the first glimpse of newborn son Vihaan with a heartfelt birthday note to husband Vicky Kaushal, even as fresh Ormax data keeps her among Bollywood's top five despite a long screen hiatus.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh's Imtiaz Ali film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' is riding strong word of mouth after its album rollout, with critics already calling the AR Rahman soundtrack a modern-day classic.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt's 'Alpha' trailer is drawing 'Boys'- and 'Game of Thrones'-style comparisons online, even as she shoots a lavish 200-dancer sequence for 'Love & War'.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra launched her new US homeware line this week and shared adorable Father's Day moments, matching sneakers with Nick Jonas and daughter Malti.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's 'King', co-starring daughter Suhana and eyeing a December 24 release, is fuelling two-part release buzz as he wraps a 'Love & War' song shoot.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan wrapped shooting Meghna Gulzar's 'Daayra' and is reportedly in talks for a Raj & DK project with Salman Khan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's 'Eetha' has locked an August 28 release, with its first teaser expected to be attached to 'Cocktail 2' as fresh Ormax data places her in Bollywood's top five.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone, expecting her second child, is balancing the 'King' shoot with Allu Arjun's 'Raaka', as makers dismiss rumours of her role being trimmed.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar' continues to post massive global numbers, delivering the highest second weekend ever for a Hindi film and overtaking Allu Arjun's records.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan's blush-pink Cannes 2026 couture with daughter Aaradhya is still trending, with Madhuri Dixit publicly defending her red-carpet look.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna's 'Cocktail 2' landed an 'A' certificate this week as she dives into intense action prep for 'Mysaa', months after marrying Vijay Deverakonda.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu penned a heartfelt note after meeting Tamil Nadu CM Vijay, saying he 'always intended to be more than a film hero', as she promotes 'Maa Inti Bangaaram'.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun responded after PM Modi showcased his 'AA23' song in a trending post, with Pooja Hegde now confirmed as his leading lady in the Lokesh Kanagaraj film.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' crossed Rs 317 crore by its second week, chasing North America box office records and ranking among the year's biggest grossers as Allu Arjun called his performance 'gritty and raw'.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' shoot resumed after a major overhaul, while 'War 2' continues to rack up records as fans hail his transformation alongside Hrithik Roshan.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor remains at the centre of the 'Peddi' objectification debate, with director Buchi Babu Sana apologising and reshooting scenes to highlight her performance.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's 'Chaand Mera Dil' with Lakshya is generating buzz despite trolling over her Bharatanatyam sequence, which choreographers defended by praising her dedication.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra welcomed their first child, a baby girl, and asked fans for privacy as they cherish the new chapter.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan is fuelling buzz with a reported 'Jailer 2' reunion alongside Rajinikanth after four decades, plus 'Krrish 4' directorial plans and a fresh Hollywood representation deal.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's David Dhawan comedy 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' opened to a solid debut, with the actor reflecting candidly on the trolling he weathered through 'Border 2'.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal released the soulful 'Nabz Nabz' female version this week and is gearing up for her global 'The Unstoppable' world tour spanning five continents.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' soundtrack is being hailed as a modern classic, as he joins Imtiaz Ali for a musical tribute to the BSF at the Attari border.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay, now Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister after his TVK party's stunning debut win, drew warm public tributes from co-stars like Samantha as he settles into the state's top office.
